title: My mobile game adventures with Claude
author: sheibeck
selftext:
I'm a web developer by trade, and game development is like a different breed of development. On the side I make table top rpgs and board games. One day, a friend of mine posted a claude artifact that had converted one of our table top games into a little web-friendly app. And suddenly the light bulb went on.   
  
I spent then next week taking all of my old PDFs and converting them into claude artifacts. One of those games was called Mazeworld, and it occurred to me that it would make a sweet mobile app. And so, Delve, Die, Repeat was born. It took me months to finally get it in a good place. I tried to stick to the rules as much as possible, but you know how that goes. Google finally approved me through to production this morning. [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.darktierstudiosllc.delvedierepeat](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.darktierstudiosllc.delvedierepeat)

For comparison there's a PDF from the rules of the game from 1994 on my website here (I'm a solo dev with an LLC just for fun). You can download the PDF for a fun comparison betwen that and where the game ended up: [https://darktierstudios.com/games](https://darktierstudios.com/games)
